# Conveyance crosses the boundary

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Read with one kind of relatum, conveyance is a candidate reading of related. A continuing family's boundary is from no step on left uncrossed, so its region is no cut in the relations; conveyance relates two conditions, which interaction, living on and descent never do.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Read with one kind of relatum, with events read stepwise (living: active and not undermining), two events at a common step are related when something is conveyed between their relata (Flow.conveyance). A relatum nothing is taken from or given to at a step is related to nothing at that step (Flow.conveyance_idle). A region's boundary is a cut in the relations when no formed relation leaves it (Flow.Cut). Under balance and dissipation, the boundary of a finite family without repetition, enclosed around from some step on, from which taking recurs, is from no step on left uncrossed (Flow.boundary_crossed), so its region is not a cut (Flow.region_not_a_cut); under relational neutrality, valuing a relatum's event reaches the living event at that step of what is conveyed into it (Flow.valuing_reaches_source). What conveyance adds is a relation between two conditions, in the direction of inflow: read with one kind of relatum, something conveyed between two conditions relates their events (Flow.roles_conveyance), while interaction, living on and descent relate no two conditions at any steps (Flow.roles_conditions_unrelated); so the clearer's resource is crossed at every step (Clearing.crossed, Clearing.resource_not_cut) and the step's fuel and the resource are related by conveyance alone (Clearing.conveyance_only). Under living on the resource's region, which the clearer lives on, is no cut either (Clearing.resource_not_cut_living_on), so a region being no cut is not itself new; what is new is the relation between conditions, and region_not_a_cut is distinctive in direction. No ethical axiom and no Lean axiom is used; relational neutrality is a hypothesis.

Canonical source: [Standpoints.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standpoints.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Conveyance as related is a correspondence premise: decided on Ren's delegation, it counts as a formed relation along which N_rel transmits, as interaction, living on and descent do.
- The one-kind reading: conditions and formations share an index, and which condition is which relatum is supplied by it (see life-as-condition-of-life).
- The crossing theorems need balance, dissipation, no repetition, enclosure around, recurring taking and decided equality, as in continuing-self-fed-from-beyond.

Ren's proposal says that the whole is perspective-dependent: “how much does one consider something to be a part of its system dynamics”. continuing-self-fed-from-beyond says that a continuing family is fed from beyond; this result reads that conveyance as a relation: with conveyance as related, a continuing family's boundary is formed and real but no cut in the relations. Unlike interaction (one draws, the other depends), living on (drawing and depending) and descent (giving as something comes to stand), conveyance relates the two ends a formation carries between: what it takes from and what it gives to. The author's reading (an AI argument): a system's boundary is crossed by the flow of what it depends on, so with conveyance as a relation, valuing one's own continuation reaches the source conveyed into it (under N_rel). This is a reading of relations, not an axiom; it does not make an unheld source held.

## Validation and boundaries

The author's counterreview is in §47 of the integration note; the independent review (CONTINUATION-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md) accepts its Lean, and its corrections are handled in §47.1–47.4 of the integration note. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 90 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

Conveyance relates events at a common step only, orders no steps, and does not ask whether what is conveyed sustains the receiver; it does not distinguish a living or held source from another; it is adopted on Ren's delegation; reaching under N_rel is the relational half of the axiom, not what the want requires; stated for the stepwise reading only; the names are the AI's wording, adopted under Ren's naming rule (conveyance, Cut and others).

- The earlier readings relate no two conditions: the clearer's fuel and resource are related by conveyance alone (Clearing.conveyance_only); under living on, though, the resource's region is no cut either (Clearing.resource_not_cut_living_on). [Standpoints.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standpoints.lean)
- An idle relatum is related to nothing by conveyance (Flow.conveyance_idle): conveyance is not free connection. [Standpoints.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standpoints.lean)
